content: firebase_admin.auth.verify_id_token(id_token, check_revoked=False, clock_skew_seconds=0): check_revoked default False => revoked/disabled users still pass; adds a backend read. Tenant-aware: verify with tenant client or read decoded firebase.tenant claim (TenantIdMismatchError). Must check auth_time for recent-auth on sensitive connect. Clock skew 0 default -> reject slightly future tokens if clock unsynced. Backend must call this on EVERY endpoint; helper require_firebase_user exists but is never called in current codebase.
